caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent, red glass bottle with a wide, rounded base that tapers into a narrow neck and flares outward slightly at the mouth. The bottle is centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. Highlights and shading on the surface of the glass indicate reflections and transparency, allowing the inner bottom rim of the bottle to be visible through its exterior. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition. The artist's signature appears near the bottom right edge of the image.
title: Decanter and Stopper
